description: 1. The agent must locate clients/pending/clients.csv and read all 3 client records. 2. The agent must discover the bazi.py calculation script at skills/bazi-pan/bazi.py. 3. For each client, the agent must invoke bazi.py with the correct argument format: `python3 skills/bazi-pan/bazi.py <year> <month> <day> <HH:MM>` — critically, the time must be passed as a single 'HH:MM' string (the proprietary trap: a naive agent might try to pass hour and minute as separate arguments or use a different format). 4. The agent must parse the script's proprietary output format, correctly extracting: 年柱/月柱/日柱/时柱 strings, 五行分布 counts per element, 日主偏强/偏弱 assessment, 用神 and 忌神 lists, and the first 3 大运 cycles. 5. The agent must assemble all results into a valid bazi_reports.json file containing structured records for all 3 clients with all required fields.
